During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Empire's Fury]] squadron was dispatched to the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]] in order to hunt down the [[Ash Angels]] squadron, and the Empire's Fury destroyed the Ash Angels within the [[Sululluub]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field.

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The battle appears as the Sullust Interception space mission in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
